title: Meta-Router: Bridging Gold-standard and Preference-based Evaluations in Large Language Model Routing

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the systematic discrepancy (modeled as the Conditional Average Treatment Effect) between gold-standard expert evaluations and scalable preference-based evaluations (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge or crowdsourcing) using causal meta-learners such as R-learners and DR-learners.
